description: Get pageview history for one specific article on a Wikimedia project over a date range, bucketed daily or monthly. Filter by access method and traffic agent. Use after wikimedia-analytics.pageviews_top to track trend history for a discovered article. Data: Wikimedia Analytics REST API (wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1), no auth required.

article.description: Article title, spaces or underscores accepted (e.g. Albert_Einstein)

project.description: Wikimedia project domain (e.g. en.wikipedia, de.wikipedia, commons.wikimedia)

name: wikimedia-analytics.pageviews.per_article

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Wikipedia Article Pageview History
